title: FoxFill
summary: Privacy-first form filling from a local profile. Scan, review, then fill — your details stay on this device.

blocks.content: Privacy-first Chrome extension that fills web forms from a locally stored profile. Current: Phase 9 — multi-profile, custom fields, encryption, full settings page (local), optional in-page overlay preview. Product rules and roadmap: PLAN.md
blocks.heading: About

sidebarNote: Download the zip and load in Chrome.
releaseNotes:
• Searchable country picker (type to find your country)
• Phone field hint follows your country dial code (+1, +44, +27, …)
• New profiles start with a country from your browser language
• Address labels adapt (State/ZIP, County/Postcode, or Province/Postal Code)
• Clearer tips — less South Africa–only wording

features.title: Local profiles
features.description: Personal and address details stored only on your device — optional passphrase encryption.

features.title: Scan → Review → Fill
features.description: Match form fields with confidence markers; you choose what to fill.

features.title: Multi-profile
features.description: Keep Personal, Work, and more — switch anytime.
